content: Light in the Sky . Stand Alone Book .  James Barrow  is an experienced  astronaut  and next in line to board the new start of the art station, exodus. A computer run station built for discovery James finds himself a month into his  yearlong  rotation  when the artifact is found and he is still there when panic engulfs the  planet,  James watches as a red mist envelops the earth and  listens as the last transmissions go out begging for help His fir st waking Upon waking he finds he has slept a thousand years not a hundred, the earth has hints of recovery, but still no transmissions, he stays awake for two months until he feels himself going a bit  mad,  so he puts himself back to sleep His second Waking Waking after yet another thousand years he still has no  transmissions but  using the optics on the now ancient station be begins to see signs of  humans,  small farms and carts, as if they have returned to an older way of life .  One Hundred Years Sleeping for only a hundred years he finds that the population is growing and then finds the probes, sending small probes to the planet he begins to listen in on life,  see the frustratingly slow progress mankind is  making,  all previous knowledge seemed forgotten .  One Hundred Years  Again James wakes and hatches a plan, using the god Aurtus and the large computer banks of knowledge he begins to contact  people,  posing as the god and helping them bring along technology to aid in the development of the planet and his possible rescue one day.
